profile.headline: Web Developer - Intermediate   at General Dynamics Information Technology
profile.summary:
Web Portal management and administration professional with over 15 years experience 

Tools:  NAVY ERP, SharePoint, Vignette Application Portal 7.2.2, Mercury Test Director/Quality Center, Telelogic Change Synergy, Telelogic DOORS, NetIQ (Web Trends Reporting Center), Dreamweaver, Microsoft Windows, MS Word, MS Excel, MS Visio, MS PowerPoint, MS SQL Server 2005, HEAT version 8.4.0 build 19, Oracle Web Center Interaction 10.3.0, SharePoint, Word Press, Mercury Test Director/Quality Center, Telelogic Change Synergy, Telelogic Doors and NetIQ (Web Trends Reporting Center), HP Fortify,  Toad v11.6.1.6

Programming:  Oracle SQL, PL/SQL, SQL Loader, HTML, XML, Web Parts, Web Services, CSS, Java Script

Security Clearance:  Secret – Active           US Citizen

positions.title: Web Developer - Intermediate
positions.description:
Develop and maintain software for Navy web applications using SQL, UNIX, JAVA, Oracle Forms, Navy ERP extractions and Oracle APEX supporting NAWC AD Comptroller customer.
Troubleshoot customer issues, user access issues, and password resets. 

Maintain user manuals for applications, How-To guides for customers and update yearly Information Assurance (IA) STIG documentation at the application level.

Maintain and run monthly, tri-annual, fiscal year-end and ad-hoc reports for the NAWCAD Comptroller/Financial team.   Successfully developed numerous applications within Oracle APEX.

Work closely with the customer and participate in technical designs, development, testing, implementation and maintenance of website enhancements. Conduct system tests, monitor test results and take appropriate corrective action. Communicate with customers and external organizations as needed.

Provided technical consultation on NAVSUP Fuel Farm hand-held scanners asp.net project and successfully completed the project.  Replaced obsolete software and hardware by working with remote team on the software rewrite and implementation. Loaded and tested all sixteen new handhelds; customer has retired old handhelds and new handhelds are out in the field. Project accomplished on time and on budget.

positions.title: Senior Operations Analyst
positions.description:
Portal Administration and Configuration Management coordinator of the MyNAVAIR Portal and NAVAIR systems.  Integrated new functional requirements into portal application development; facilitated the planning, prioritization, development, and implementation of new content to existing and new audiences within MyNAVAIR; executed operational oversight of the end user experience for all production portal functions and features. Portal and general configuration management responsibilities included: facilitating change management, system upgrades, security, and training; collaborating with policy makers, advocating the use of new technology to enhance the experience for NAVAIR users.
Knowledge of commercial portal technology and portal implementation; ability to implement and follow Configuration Management guidelines as they relate to the portal to include: maintaining/tracking software/hardware configuration and software/hardware change management and strong communication, presentation and documentation skills. 
Work effectively with internal clients and external consultants to gather the software requirements about how their Communities should be set-up to include: security, layout, and content and portlet functionality. Develop test cases and participate in system testing, regression testing and defect testing through development, integration and production stages. Translate functional requirements into system and design documents for the development teams.
Create and monitor system change requests, prioritize and analyze help desk calls and troubleshooting.
Assist developers in understanding the general portal product functionality to allow them to develop custom applications. Run SQL queries to assist with user account questions and monthly statistics. 
Troubleshoot issues related to NMCI Network, customer workstations (i.e. browser settings, application requirements). This requires knowledge of NMCI and its limitations.

positions.title: Technical Engineer II - UAT, System Integration Testing and Regression Testing
positions.description: Performed web-based system, regression and integration testing to ensure projects met end-user requirements that did not adversely affect current functionality of the portal. Translated system requirements specifications into test cases/scenarios and created master project test plans. Documented defects and worked closely with developers to speed resolution. Performed and managed portal administration tasks such as quality assurance, modified permissions, client groups, created and modified modules, pages and portal content. Utilized Vignette Application Portal (VAP), Data Model, Dynamic HTML, Mercury Quality Center, Telelogic Change Synergy and Toad.

positions.title: Quality Assurance Specialist
positions.description: Resolved customer retention issues, maintained quality control/satisfaction records, continually sought new ways to improve customer service. Worked with customers on invoice-reconciliation and negotiated resolutions to save accounts. Met with corporate clients to review accounts, make adjustments, upgrade equipment and provide guidance on equipment usage.  Awarded the Top Performance six times for resolving and retaining corporate customer’s accounts.
